name: Temu
notes: 12.5M statements over 2026-08-09..09-07, 63% DE-scoped, 9,579 Article 16. Dominated by UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS (244k of 378k on a sample day).

name: Shein
notes: 210k over the same window, 86% DE-scoped, 651 Article 16 — two orders of magnitude below the other three, so its numbers are readable rather than merely plottable.

name: TikTok
notes: 49.9M, 99% DE-scoped. Composition differs sharply from the marketplaces: SCAMS_AND_FRAUD and DATA_PROTECTION dominate, UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS is near zero.

name: Zalando
notes: 195 statements in 30 days (~6/day). Kept as a European comparator but off by default until a client asks for it.

name: Amazon Store
notes: 197M in 30 days, the largest filer. Off by default: it is a competitor benchmark rather than a client brand, and each enabled platform costs two /count calls per day.
